validation_scope.characters: Unchanged NPC/legacy/follower sources. Native Sprite_Character default four-direction/four-column crop, original origins, resource switches, timing at four speeds, and actual PictureEx throwing for five-cell legacy strips. Fixed shadowless neutral fixtures are compatibility rendering; not proof of every map-event/follower AI or roof/water interaction.
validation_scope.outfits: All remaining clothing/hair/hat/held-ball sources decoded. Sources matching current filename routes exercised through actual Sprite_Player/Sprite_Wearable or portrait compositor, four directions/motion cells; hair/hats through seven action/return states, clothing in its own action. Fixed baseline appearance, not all Cartesian combinations or map events. Existing route mismatches and nonstandard sheets listed separately and retained unchanged.
validation_scope.battle-art: All alternate/special/egg/joke/triple sources retained unchanged. Actual PokemonBattlerSprite custom-file override path, front/back scaling/mirroring, bottom-center origin and complete 24-update selection/target cycles. Species metadata from leading base number where valid, otherwise fixed species-1 compatibility fixture. This does not assert every triple/egg is mapped to that species or replace actual egg/hatching gameplay; source identity preserved byte-for-byte.
validation_scope.ui: All 658 unchanged UI/intro sources decoded. Actual bilingual SlotMachine three difficulties/full reel loops/stop, Mining tool-hit animation and tile depths, five TilePuzzle rotation loops, Voltorb board/tile animation, full 230-frame Movie at two updates per frame and skip path. Other decorative/mail/roulette/compatibility assets retained byte-identically after visual/use review; not every minigame outcome or complete event/startup flow.

limitations: No complete gameplay/map-event regression, exhaustive clothing combinations, Android physical-device or release-package validation. P3 completion includes documented preservation; it is not a claim that every image was redrawn.
